use default

mod_pow(base: long, exponent: long, modulus: long) -> long is
    let result mut = 1L
    let factor mut = base % modulus
    let remaining mut = exponent

    while remaining > 0L do
        if remaining % 2L == 1L then
            result = result * factor % modulus
        fi

        factor = factor * factor % modulus
        remaining = remaining / 2L
    od

    result
si

is_prime(value: int) -> bool =>
    value > 1 /\ ((2..value)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= value)
        |> all(divisor => value % divisor != 0))

divisors(value: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    for candidate in 1::value do
        if candidate * candidate > value then break fi

        if value % candidate == 0 then
            yield candidate

            if value / candidate != candidate then
                yield value / candidate
            fi
        fi
    od
si

splits_repeated_doubling(value: int) -> bool =>
    let wide = cast long(value) in
    mod_pow(2L, wide, wide) == 2L % wide

is_super_poulet(value: int) -> bool =>
    splits_repeated_doubling(value) /\
        !is_prime(value) /\
        (divisors(value) |> all(splits_repeated_doubling))

let found =
    from(3, 2)
        |> filter(is_super_poulet)
        |> take_while(value => value < 10_100_000)
        |> collect()

write_line("the first 20 super-Poulet numbers:")
write_line("  {found |> take(20) |> join(" ")}")
write_line()

[1_000_000, 10_000_000]
    |> each(bound => (
        let passed = found |> take_while(value => value <= bound) |> count()

        write_line("super-Poulet number {passed + 1} is the first over "
                   "{bound:N0}: {found[passed]:N0}")
    ))
